label: AI-OPERATED FIXED-MAP A* TIE COMPARISON; SYNTHETIC GRID

scenario.contributor: Junmo — guided pattern and dead-end length selection
scenario.assistance: Student selected the pattern, chose length 4 and supplied the qualitative pre-run expectation. AI supplied the base layout/options, transcribed inputs and will implement/operate the paired comparison. No independent full-map design or student code authorship is inferred.
scenario.prediction: Student expects similar examined-node counts for FIFO and closer-goal on this selected map. This is qualitative; no numerical tolerance, exact-equality claim or rationale was supplied.
scenario.controls: Four-connected unit cost, same map/endpoints, Manhattan heuristic, neighbor order, goal handling and budget. Only A* equal-f ordering changes. Budget 300 exceeds the total 21 cells; this comparison isolates examined-node counts without selecting a cutoff after results.
scenario.comparisonScope: One guided hand-constructed map, not a random-map performance estimate. Compare valid path lengths, examined nodes and failure status; retain equal or unfavorable results.
scenario.executionNote: Prediction recorded before execution. Explicitly pass each A* tieBreak option in the paired runner; the original fixed-scenario runner evaluates FIFO only. Report actual differences without defining a post-hoc tolerance for similar.

conventions.primaryScore: Both A* variants use g+h; only equal-f ordering differs.
conventions.examinedNodes: Distinct examined nodes, including start and goal; not runtime or energy.
conventions.pathLength: Number of moves, excluding the start cell.
conventions.reference: Dijkstra shares the planner; independent BFS audit is in test/audit.test.mjs.
conventions.attribution: Input retains guided student choices and forecast; evaluator and execution are AI support.

execution.provenance: Student supplied guided choices and forecast; this command is assistant-operated. No student execution or independent map sample is inferred.
